name: Billing & Store (Stripe)
author: OwnPBX
description: Monthly plans through Stripe that set what each user gets: outside call minutes, text messages and fax. Users subscribe, switch and cancel themselves; a public Store takes sign-ups that wait for your approval before anyone is charged. Limits can be watched before they are enforced.

description_i18n.en: Monthly plans through Stripe that set what each user gets: outside call minutes, text messages and fax. Users subscribe, switch and cancel themselves; a public Store takes sign-ups that wait for your approval before anyone is charged. Limits can be watched before they are enforced.

settings_schema.label: Enforce limits
settings_schema.help: On: users are stopped at their plan's limits. Off: usage is only counted and shown.

settings_schema.label: Stripe secret key
settings_schema.help: sk_test_… while testing, sk_live_… for real payments.

settings_schema.label: Stripe webhook signing secret
settings_schema.help: whsec_… from the webhook endpoint you add in Stripe.

settings_schema.label: Currency
settings_schema.help: ISO code, e.g. usd, eur, gbp.

settings_schema.label: No plan: outside call minutes
settings_schema.help: Per month for users without a plan. -1 = unlimited, 0 = none.

settings_schema.label: No plan: text messages
settings_schema.help: Per month for users without a plan. -1 = unlimited, 0 = none.

settings_schema.label: No plan: fax
settings_schema.help: Users without a plan may send faxes.

settings_schema.label: No plan: faxes sent
settings_schema.help: Per month for users without a plan. -1 = unlimited, 0 = none.

settings_schema.label: Public Store
settings_schema.help: Open the Store. Sign-ups wait for your approval; nobody is charged before it.

settings_schema.label: Store: first extension
settings_schema.help: First extension number given to approved customers.

settings_schema.label: Store: last extension
settings_schema.help: Last extension number given to approved customers.
